high_level_overview.overview: The INTCALC job processes a transaction balance file to compute interest and fees for credit card accounts, executing program CBACT04C with a processing date parameter of July 18, 2022. It reads from multiple VSAM datasets including transaction category balances, card cross-reference data, account data, and discount group information. The job produces a new generation of a transaction output dataset (SYSTRAN GDG +1) containing the calculated results, supporting the CardDemo credit card processing application.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The job name that uniquely identifies this job to the system. It is used for tracking, scheduling, and referencing the job in the JES spool and system logs.

parameters.name: ACCOUNTING INFORMATION
parameters.description: A positional parameter providing accounting or identification information for the job. It is used for billing, auditing, or descriptive purposes and appears in job logs and accounting records.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is assigned. It determines the scheduling priority and resource allocation rules applied by JES when selecting the job for execution.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (JES message log), which includes JCL listing, allocation/termination messages, and system messages. It controls where the job log is routed after job completion.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified upon job completion. The symbolic parameter &SYSUID resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, sending a notification message when the job finishes.

job_details.purpose: Processes the transaction category balance file to compute interest and fees for credit card accounts, and writes the resulting transaction records to a new generation of the transaction output file.
job_details.inputs: TCATBALF (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS), XREFFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS), XREFFIL1 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH), ACCTFILE (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS), DISCGRP (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DISCGRP.VSAM.KSDS); PARM='2022071800'
job_details.outputs: TRANSACT (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN(+1), new GDG generation, RECFM=F, LRECL=350); SYSPRINT, SYSOUT

data_operations.description: Load library accessed to load and execute program CBACT04C
Transaction category balance file read via DD TCATBALF to retrieve transaction balance data for interest and fee computation
Card cross-reference VSAM KSDS file read via DD XREFFILE to look up card-to-account cross-reference data
Alternate index path for card cross-reference file accessed via DD XREFFIL1 to support alternate key lookups
Account data VSAM KSDS file accessed via DD ACCTFILE to read and update account balances, interest, and fee information
Discount group VSAM KSDS file read via DD DISCGRP to retrieve interest rate and fee group definitions for accounts
New GDG generation of the transaction output file created and written via DD TRANSACT with RECFM=F, LRECL=350, allocated on SYSDA with space of 1 cylinder
